```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


```{r process_raw_data}

#read in raw data
penguins_raw <- read.csv("../data/raw/penguins_raw.csv")

#run process on raw data
penguins_na_omit <- na.omit(penguins_raw)
                          
```

```{r save_intermediate_data}

#save intermediate data to appropriate output directory in the intermediate data directory
write.csv(penguins_na_omit, file = "../data/intermediate/f01_preprocess_penguins/penguins_na_omit.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```
